jesse ringo.name: Jesse Ringo
jesse ringo.origin: Jesse Ringo was a famous gunslinger who adapted his gun by saying that he had made it invincible. Years later when it reappeared, the gun was used to carry out crimes convincing whoever using it became invincible to the point that a criminal dared to challenge the Two-Gun Kid but he was defeated soundly so that the Kid showed that even if it was a well-built gun, it did not was invincible but its fame almost hypnotized the adversary making it seem so. The gun was finally handed over to Jesse's son, who wanted it to remember his dead father.

jessica carradine.name: Jessica Carradine
jessica carradine.origin: Jessica Carradine was Ben Reilly's girlfriend. Before she and Ben even met, it was clear that she and Spider-Man had a history together. Going for a walk one night, Jessica saw Ben swing away and she instantly ran for her camera, saying, "Spider-Man! After all this time...I was beginning to think I'd never get the chance!" She managed to get a picture of Spider-Man battling the armor suited Armada, and a friend told her that she should sell the picture to the Daily Bugle like Peter Parker. J. Jonah Jameson liked her work and gave her a job. She hoped to get assigned to a developing Spider-Man story, one involving a skeleton found in a smoke stack that wore a tattered Spider-Man costume. She mentioned this to Ben at the Daily Grind coffee bar, where Ben worked as a waiter. Ben barely managed to hide his shock at hearing this news, but was lucky to be sent on an errand by the Grind's owner, Shirley Washington. Spider-Man went to the morgue to investigate the skeleton and Jessica planned a surprise house warming party for Ben with Shirley. Meanwhile, Spider-Man was trying to sneak out of the morgue with the skeleton, when he was confronted by JJJ, who also wanted to look at the remains. Spidey webbed Jonah's eyes and jumped out a window but Jameson had already started screaming that he was going to expose Spider-Man as a murderer. Ben was on his way to hide the bones before he could find a place to analyze them, but he was interrupted by a brawl between the Rhino and the recently revived Kaine. Spider-Man got caught in the middle and ended up getting a brick wall dropped on top of him. Arriving back at his apartment, Ben saw Jessica waiting for him with the TV that his friends had chipped in to buy for him. Everyone else had gone home when Ben didn't show up but Jessica stayed and fussed over Ben's bruises. Ben got attached to Jessica very quickly, but he soon began to wonder about her past. It started when he was at her apartment and saw her walls covered with photos of Spider-Man. She insisted that she was just trying to see what pictures worked and which ones didn't. She got defensive when Ben didn't trust her, which he apologized for. She reminded him that no one has ever trusted her. She had been sent from foster home to foster home for years because her mother ran out on her and her father was in prison. He had been jailed for the murder of Benjamin Parker, whom her father told her had mistaken him for a burglar. They struggled and the old man's gun went off, killing him. When her father got out of prison, he took care of her for a short while before he died. Seeing Jameson accuse Spider-Man of covering up the "murder" of the man whose skeleton was in the smoke stack further convinced Jessica that Spider-Man was a killer. While Peter and Ben took the skeleton to the Avengers to have it analyzed, Peter took the opportunity to examine a photograph of Jessica and her father, whose face was unclear in the photo. Upon seeing the clearer resolution, Peter instantly recognized Jessica's father as the burglar that killed Uncle Ben. While Ben had no idea what to do with this new bit of information, Jessica was still determined to prove that Spider-Man was a maniac. She got her wish when the Carnage symbiote escaped from Ravencroft Asylum and bonded to Ben, causing him to tear New York apart. Spider-Carnage barely managed to keep from killing Jessica, and they swung away before they did anything more than smash her camera. Ben avoided Jessica over the next few days, partly because of his being bonded to the Carnage symbiote and partly out of discomfort of knowing about her father. After Jessica caught up to him at the Daily Grind, he managed to get her to tell him more about her father. Jessica believed that Spider-Man planted evidence on her father to frame him for Ben Parker's murder. After he was released from jail, Jessica said that he tried to start a new and honest life but Spider-Man caught him in a warehouse. He beat her father and eventually strangled him to death, and the coroner called the cause of a death a heart attack. But Jessica was sure that she knew the truth: the coroner must have lied to protect Spider-Man. As they were walking to dinner, a S.W.A.T. van sped past, alerting them to a jewelry store robbery nearby. Ben went to help with the hostages, while Jessica grabbed her camera. After the thieves were caught and the hostages were safe, Spider-Man swung off to an alley way to change back into Ben Reilly. Little did he know, Jessica had climbed to a nearby rooftop and was watching him with her telescope camera lens. Upon feeling his spider sense buzz, Ben rushed to the spot of the danger and saw a nearly hysterical rage within Jessica. She stormed away, telling him that she never wanted to see him again. Later that night, a calmer Jessica decided that her photo of an unmasked Spider-Man was the perfect means to revenge. Meanwhile, a pair of cops arrived at the Daily Grind looking for Ben Reilly

jessica drew.name: Jessica Drew
jessica drew.species: Human genetically mutated with the DNA of many species of spiders
jessica drew.origin: ===Early Life=== Born in England, when Jessica Drew was about a year old, her parents moved from their apartment in Paris to a small cottage in the outskirts of Wundagore Mountain in Transia. Her father, Jonathan Drew, geneticist and research partner to the man who would later become the High Evolutionary, found large amounts of uranium in their property, which gave them the financial resources to build a research facility to keep working on their controversial studies of evolution, genetics and cell regeneration. As a child, Jessica often played with a local boy by the name of Phillip Masters. ===Experiment=== thumb|left|200px|Jonathan Drew introduces the serum of his daughter In the course of the next three years, life was good, until little Jessica became ill, poisoned by her long-time exposure to the uranium that was so prevalent in their land. Jonathan, being an expert on the regenerative and immunological properties of arachnids' blood, injected Jessica with an untested serum made with the blood of several uncommon species of spiders, in the hopes of stopping the tissue damage and immunizing the girl from the uranium radiation in her blood. Then, he sealed her in a genetic accelerator created by Herbert Wyndham, a.k.a. the High Evolutionary, to speed the process, but it only seemed to work at a very slow rate. Jess was kept in stasis for decades, while the chamber holding her kept her aging greatly slowed until the treatments finally finished in recent years. During many of those years, Jess's mother Miriam awaited her return, but due to age needed Wyndham to make a clone to continue her vigilance. Now a full-grown woman with little life experience, Jessica found herself unwelcome among the New Men of Wundagore, who sensed the difference of her hybrid nature, as well as her human form upsetting them. ===Made for Hydra=== right|thumb|225px|Flumm brainwashes young Jessica Drew Jessica eventually set off on her own, leaving the Citadel of Science and found work as a barmaid in a nearby village. She also experienced her first romance, which tragically ended when an innocent prank panicked the young woman and she accidentally triggered a bioelectric blast that killed her boyfriend. Accused of witchcraft and murder, Jessica fled from an enraged mob into the clutches of Otto Vermis. The wealthy Vermis offered sanctuary to Jessica as a high-ranking leader in Hydra, an international terrorist movement. Vermis trained Jessica in the use of her powers and taught her espionage, martial arts, and various killing techniques. Hydra wanted to mold Jessica into the perfect assassin. Her mind already in a state of shock after the death of her boyfriend, Jessica lost all memory of her life before meeting Vermis, even her name. Mentallo used his powers to convince her that Hydra was an organization that fights the encroaching powers of corporations. However, she rebelled on a basic level against them, going so far as to deviate from their conformity by making her first costume red instead of green. In her first and only field assignment for Hydra, Jessica refused to assassinate S.H.I.E.L.D. Director Nick Fury. Rebelling against Hydra, Jessica defeated Vermis in a battle to the death. Before he died, Vermis tricked Jessica into believing that she was originally an artificially evolved spider instead of a mutated human. ===Spider-Woman=== Distraught by what she learned, Jessica wandered Europe until a clash with Hydra in London brought her into contact with the Thing and Modred the Mystic. Modred magically revealed the truth of Jessica's true origins, and she lived briefly in London. While living in her ramshackle apartment in London, she broke into a nearby convenience store looking for food, but she immediately started to regret her actions and dropped the cans of food. She didn't want to doom her future by resorting to theft, so she left but not before she was spotted by Jerry Hunt, a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. During her continued desperate attempts to find employment, she was recognized and then hounded by Hunt, and was forced to go dark. Weeks later, in order to disguise herself better, she dyed her hair black and created a secret identity for herself. After that, she went out on patrol despite not wanting to be a hero. She would encounter Hunt and the local police again, who were involved in a firefight with two thieves she had met before. She defeated the duo and managed to save Hunt's life by using her own laser-resistant blood. left|thumb|2-0px|Jessica Drew dying her hair She was later approached by the mysterious sorcerer named Magnus. Magnus tutored her in the ways of civilization and informed her that her father was murdered, leading her on a hunt for his killer. Jessica traveled to the west coast of the United States to Los Angeles with Magnus, where they presented themselves as uncle and niece and began living with the Dolly family in North Hollywood. jessica jones.origin: ===Early Life=== right|thumb|150px|Jessica Campbell Jessica Campbell was born and raised in Forest Hills, Queens, New York City. She attended Midtown High School along with Peter Parker where they shared several classes. She developed a crush on Peter, but never told him. She followed him to the New York Hall of Science, where she was about to approach him, but he was bitten by the radioactive spider that granted him his superpowers. As Peter left the building; Jessica followed after him, but lost sight of him and was nearly run down by an Ajax Atomic Labs truck before a man pulled her to safety, and Jessica then fled the scene. At home that night, Jessica tried to pleasure herself to her pictures of the Human Torch, but was interrupted by her younger brother Phillip. The family later went on a trip to Disney World with tickets given to them by her father's boss, Tony Stark. On the way home Jessica argued with her brother, before the car collided with a military convoy carrying radioactive chemicals. Her family was killed, and she was exposed to the chemicals. After spending several months in a coma, Jessica was placed in an orphanage, the Moore House for Wayward Children, and was later adopted by Alisa Jones and her husband, legally taking their last name. After her recovery, Jessica discovered that she had developed superhuman powers such as strength and durability. left|thumb|150px|First time flying Her new family re-enrolled Jessica at Midtown High, where she was ostracized by her classmates, especially the school bully Flash Thompson. Peter tried to befriend Jessica, feeling she was a kindred spirit as they had both lost family members. Jessica, however, mistook his kind attention and lashed out at him, believing he was merely pitying her. When she ran away she discovered that she could fly, although she lost control and crashed into the Hudson River. She was rescued by Thor. While trying out her powers, she accidentally crash-landed on the Scorpion, who was robbing a laundromat. This was enough to stun him so he could be apprehended. It was while witnessing a fight between Spider-Man and Sandman in her own class that she realized she could use her powers for good. ===Jewel=== right|thumb|Jewel Jessica attempted to become a super heroine, calling herself Jewel, and was active for about four years. She met and teamed up with Ms. Marvel during a fight with Doctor Octopus. Jessica also teamed up with both Power Man and Iron Fist early into their careers, and the trio took a picture together to celebrate, something she would later do after teaming up with the Avengers as well. She teamed up with the Thing, though years later he would have no recollection of their meeting. She also fought alongside future boyfriend Scott Lang during his early days as Ant-Man. Some of her adventures included rescuing an elderly woman from muggers , and fighting off the Skrulls in Central Park. ===The Purple Man=== left|thumb|Meeting Purple Man One day, she happened upon a fistfight in a restaurant, and discovered that Zebediah Killgrave aka the Purple Man had told the men to fight. Killgrave then overpowered Jessica's will and told her to "take care of the police" so that he could finish his meal, which she did. Jessica was captured by the Purple Man and kept prisoner for eight months, though she was never used for sexual means. However, she was used by Purple Man as an accomplice in his schemes, such as bank robberies , and was forced to hurt people. She was eventually sent to attack the red-costumed Daredevil and kill anyone who got in the way after a newspaper report angered Killgrave. Jessica became disoriented once she was out of range of the pheromones produced by Killgrave but, having been under his control for so long, she was still focused on her mission. She ended up attacking the Scarlet Witch because her costume was red, like Daredevil's. After hitting The Scarlet Witch, she snapped out of Killgrave's control. Thinking the gathered Avengers and Defenders would attack her, Jessica ran away, but was found and nearly killed by the Vision and Iron Man. Jean Grey of the X-Men helped awaken Jessica from another coma. Following several months of recovery, she began dating Clay Quartermain and was asked to join The Avengers as a S.H.I.E.L.D. liaison, but declined the offer. ===Knightresss=== right|thumb|Knightress Still bitter about her experience, Jessica briefly became a hardened vigilante, calling herself Knightress. However, her stint as Knightress only lasted for about a week. Intercepting a crime meeting between the Owl and a mafioso, she first encountered Luke Cage. After defeating the Owl and his goons, she discovered that one of the thugs had brought his children with him. She took off her mask and revealed her identity to the cops so that they would allow her to look after the children for the night. Luke went to her home later that night and the two had a long talk. At one point Jessica dated Daimon Hellstrom

fields.additional_attributes: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder: Jessica was traumatized by her time spent with the Purple Man. He affected her mind so much that she did not know what were her own thoughts. It took months of therapy with Jean Grey to help her through it. However she at first became a violent vigilante and later quit the hero life all together. Alcoholism: Jessica coped with her trauma through alcohol regularly drinking to forget her troubles. She quit after her daughter was born but has occasionally relapsed in her old habits.
transportation: Flight under her own power.
fields.notes: right|thumb|75px|Jessica's retconned first chronological appearance While Jessica Jones' first appearance came in , her history was later retconned in to make her one of Peter Parker's high school classmates appearing as early as , where she was in the crowd encouraging the fight between Sandman and Spider-Man. This revelation contradicts other aspects of Jessica's life. In Amazing Spider-Man (Vol. 2) #601, Jessica mentions she already possessed her powers when she witnessed Spider-Man's fight against Sandman. However, in , it was established Jessica woke up from the coma around the time of the Galactus Trilogy, which took place a long time after Amazing Spider-Man #4. According to the Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe and Official Index to the Marvel Universe writer Jeph York, Marvel's official stance is that Galactus was not present when Jessica awoke from her coma, and his cameo in #22 should be ignored and considered "art error."
fields.trivia: The priest who performed the wedding ceremony for Jessica Jones and Luke Cage bore an uncanny resemblance to Stan Lee. It is rumored that Brian Michael Bendis originally wanted to use original Spider-Woman Jessica Drew as the starring character in Alias, but Marvel balked at using the character in an adult-oriented series, so Bendis created Jessica Jones as a replacement. Bendis has denied this. Upon finding out Spider-Man's secret identity as Peter Parker, Jessica was dismayed to learn from him that he and many others at school only knew her as "Coma Girl" after her accident. Jessica gained a few admirers during her tenure as Jewel, such as the Young Avengers members Hulkling, Wiccan, and Hawkeye, as well as former co-worker Kat Farrell, Avengers Academy student Reptil, and even a young Kang the Conqueror. Jessica as Jewel is the subject of one of Wolverine's sexual fantasies. right|thumb|200px|Jessica's concussive blasts. In a dream sequence in , Jessica is shown fighting the Defenders while under the control of the Purple Man. During this dream sequence, she is shown producing pink concussive blasts to use against both the Defenders as well as Thor. This power has never been shown again or addressed. However, the dream sequence was drawn by Mark Bagley, who illustrated all Jewel flashbacks in the series, hinting it might actually be a memory. Jessica's blood type is B. For her wedding, she wore morning blush shade of lipstick. This was also the color of her favorite flower, roses. Her first pet was named Planet Terry. At the age of 15, Jessica's favorite book was .

jessica shannon.origin: Jessica Shannon is one of the main protagonists of Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers and is the holder of Wasp's DISK. She is from a rich French family, naive and can come across as selfish. This is largely because she was often left alone due to her parents being busy with work, and thus not very sociable. Because of this she became afraid to let others get too close to her. However, she was raised to follow the principle of "nobleness oblige", basically using your wealth to help others whenever you can. She can also be very competitive when it comes to games. Jessica was participating in a guided tour by Phil Coulson when Loki and his henchmen attacked the Raft and released multiple super-villains. In the chaos that followed, Jessica, along with Edward and Chris, ran into Akira and Hikaru, who had been ordered by their father, Nozomu Akatsuki, to keep the last Biocode Installer out of the hands of the villains. When Jessica and her new friends saw King Cobra holding Pepper Potts hostage, they rescued her by luring King Cobra towards a group of containers, and dropping these on top of him with a forklift truck. When M.O.D.O.K. tried to destroy the installer, the installer gave all five kids, including Jessica, a biocode. Jessica received the yellow biocode. Now that she had a biocode and was thus one of the very few people in the world who could D-smash heroes and villains from their DISKs, Spider-Man tried to convince Jessica to join the other four kids and the Avengers. Jessica refused however since she was too busy with other things, but she soon got dragged into the adventure anyway when the Celebrity Five abducted her and imprisoned her on board their ship along with Edward. At Jessica's request, the two of them attempted an escape, and in the process Jessica stole a biocode bracelet and the DISK containing Wasp. She used these to D-Smash Wasp so she could free the captured Spider-Man. While Spider-Man covered their escape, Jessica and Edward, hunted by King Cobra, managed to send out an SOS. Not much later, Akira, Hikaru, Pepper Potts, Chris, Iron Man, Captain America and Thor came to rescue them. Jessica then officially joined the others in the quest to fight off Loki and hunt down the DISKs containing the super-villains. Despite now being part of the team, Jessica still didn't want the other kids to become her friends out of fear that one day they would see through her guise of a happy, rich girl, and notice her more embarrassing sides. This became particularly noticeable when the team had to travel to France to find a DISK hidden underneath Jessica's own house. Around her parents, she acted even more distant towards her teammates than usual. When Akira rescued her from a booby trap in the underground tunnel where the DISK was located, she scolded him for risking his life like that rather than being thankful. When Akira called her out on her behavior, Jessica stormed off, leaving the others to deal with Tim Gilliam and Dr. Octopus. It took an encouraging speech from Wasp to make Jessica realize her friends wouldn't abandon her because of her more negative characteristics, and that she didn't have to do everything alone. Jessica returned to the fight just in time to save the others and helped to defeat Dr. Octopus, as well as retrieve the DISK. During the battle with Loki in the latters Ice Palace, Jessica managed to synchronize her biocode with her partner, thus giving Wasp the ability to draw power from her and extend her time limit. When Red Skull started his plan to destroy the world and the Avengers had to split up to take out his 5 bases of operation, Jessica and Wasp were tasked with taking out the base guarded by Tiger Shark, located in Wakanda. In this fight they teamed up with Wakanda's king, Black Panther. Together they managed to not only destroy the base, but also free the people that Tiger Shark had taken hostage. In the fight, Black Panther was D-secured by Tiger Shark, and thus became Jessica's second partner. After the other Avengers had also succeeded in their missions, Jessica, Wasp and Black Panther helped to defeat Red Skull's giant robot, and Red Skull himself. Jessica's loyalty to her partner became clear once more when she supported Wasp's decision to help Hank Pym escape from S.H.I.E.L.D. after his robot Ultron went rogue and the World Security Council ordered for him to be arrested. While visiting a museum at night, Jessica became a victim of the vampire Baron Blood and was seemingly turned into a vampire herself. She thus became loyal to Blood and attacked Akira and Iron Man. Iron Man discovered however that Jessica's biocode, which had for some time been evolving now, had prevented her from turning into a vampire, and that Jessica was instead only believing herself to be a vampire. However, she was raised to follow the principle of "nobleness oblige", basically using your wealth to help others whenever you can. She can also be very competitive when it comes to games. Her father died before she was born, and her mother disappeared alongside the Invisible Woman following the "Great Cataclysm". Jessie became a S.W.A.T. team officer and joined up with the last incarnation of the Avengers when asked. Jessie was killed by the Grim Reaper during the 'final battle' of the Avengers when he impaled her with his scythe.

jessie clatterbuck.name: Jessie Clatterbuck
jessie clatterbuck.origin: Jessie Clatterbuck is a Bostrum-Class Life Model Decoy, Call Sign B-6556. During the implosion of A.I.M., Jessie hideout like many of the other Bostrum-Class L.M.D.s. Without any family of her own, Jessie set out to make a family. She married and adopted a human girl named Joelynn. Unfortunately, one day while playing hide-and-seek, Joelynn fell out of a tree and died. Stricken with grief, Jessie and her husband soon went through an ugly divorce. Left again without family, Jessie turned to her fellow L.M.D.s for support. Jessie unwittingly became apart of Dimitrios rebellion when she agreed to deliver a thumb drive to a local nonprofit for her friend and fellow L.M.D. Carlos. This triggered a hijack of multiple satellites, which launched missile strikes on oil pumping sites leading to an artificial increase in the price of gas. The thumb drive also loaded a Trojan Horse malware virus into Jessie. Next Dimitrios led S.H.I.E.L.D. to find Jessie with the plan of using her to infiltrate their entire operation. To prevent Dimitrios' conquering of Earth and the extinction of humanity, Captain Alexis from the future came back to warn modern-day Alexis. Thanks to the intervention of the A.I. Avengers and Monica Chang, Jessie was spared and Dimitrios' plans were thwarted. Jessie later relocated to the The Diamond and was welcomed into the Lovelace Army.

jessie connelly.name: Jessie Connelly
jessie connelly.origin: Jessie Connelly was the father of David Connelly. Although he had opposed his son's marriage to Elizabeth Hart, he put aside his disagreements when David and Elizabeth disappeared while traveling through the Everglades. Joining Elizabeth's parents in the search, Jessie eventually discovered the young couple's bodies and learned that their newborn child was missing. Following the infant's trail into the swamp, Jessie encountered Man-Thing holding the baby. While Elizabeth's parents reacted with fear and hostility toward the creature, Jessie remained calm and approached without panic. As a result, Man-Thing did not attack him. After the frightened Harts were killed by the creature's burning touch, Jessie gently took custody of his grandchild. He left the swamp with the infant, intending to raise the child himself, unaware that Man-Thing's contact had somehow purged the contamination from the baby's body.

jessie drake.name: Jessie Drake
jessie drake.origin: Jessie was kidnapped by the Fortress for study, so Professor X sent Wolverine to retrieve her. Wolverine convinced Typhoid Mary to rescue Jessie. She eventually succeeded and they then arrived at a women's shelter. The man-hating Bloody Mary persona fronted and knocked Jessie unconscious when one of the workers at the shelter referred to Jessie as a boy instead of her preferred identity. When Jessie woke up, she went after Mary. Upon finding her, she revealed that she was a trans girl. Mary accepted this, allowing a calmer alter to front, and the two went in for psychiatry together. Years later, Jessie and Black Cat destroyed the Fortress together.

fields.notes: Jessie's appearance tends to reflect the appearances of the people surrounding her. Her hair color or eye color shifts within panels, and she becomes more masculine or feminine in appearance at various points. While talking to Typhoid Mary and trying to bond with her, she copied Mary's red hair and part of her appearance. Though she was considerably shorter than Mary, she started looking like a younger look-alike of her new traveling companion. Years later, Jessie briefly transformed herself into a shorter look-alike of the Black Cat. She seems unable to change her own height when transforming. Jessie used her empathic powers to calm down Mary's multiple alters. She also helped Mary to establish a new and less lethal alter, under the name of "Walker." Jessie used her empathic powers to increase the Black Cat's fear response. The mercenary Steel Raven was Jessie's first known foe, and she was reportedly targeting Jessie again, long after the Fortress organization shut down. Jessie was unaware of Raven's actual motivations. Jessie demonstrated seemingly new illusion powers in a confrontation with the Black Cat, causing Felicia to see ghostly apparitions. The Cat simply used her electromagnetic lenses to see through the illusions. Jessie initially thought that Steel Raven and the Black Cat were the same person, based on their physical similarities. Both women had platinum blonde hair and similar body-types. Raven had also actually impersonated the Cat in the then-recent past. The Black Cat offered an alliance against Steel Raven to Jessie, and then invited the younger girl to have dinner with her at a restaurant. Jessie was not certain if the Cat was asking her out on a dinner date, but she gladly accepted. She had previously expressed her appreciation for Felicia's physical form when Felicia tackled her to the ground during their fight, and their banter was flirtatious.
fields.trivia: Jessie came out as a transgender girl in and is the first openly transgender character in the Marvel Universe.

jessan hoan.name: Jessán Hoan
jessan hoan.origin: ===Early Life=== Jessán Hoan was born and raised in Singapore as a member of a successful banking family. Following the family profession, she attended Harvard Business School, graduating magna cum laude, before returning to Singapore and taking a position at her family's Hoan International Bank. Though comparatively small, the institution had become successful enough to attract the attention of its competitors. The rival Meridian Bank feared the Hoan family's growing influence and secretly hired the Madripoor crime lord Roche to eliminate the competition. Roche in turn contracted the Reavers, who attacked Hoan International Bank while Jessán was working there. The Reavers massacred several members of her family and the bank's personnel, but spared Jessán because they believed her financial expertise could be useful to them. They abducted her and carried her to their Australian base at Cooterman's Creek. There, Pretty Boy attempted to cybernetically reprogram Jessán. The Reavers wanted her to administer the financial side of their criminal operation, but considered her morality, scruples and compassion liabilities. Pretty Boy therefore began erasing those restraints while downloading new knowledge and skills into her mind. The process was interrupted when the X-Men attacked the Reavers and rescued her. After debating what to do with her, the X-Men released Jessán, and their ally Roma returned her to the time and place from which she had been abducted. Jessán returned to the ruins of her family's bank as one of the massacre's only survivors. Rather than being welcomed home, her mysterious survival made her a pariah among both her extended family and Singapore's financial community. Banks refused to employ her, but she found herself unexpectedly unconcerned by the damage to her reputation. Investigating what had happened, Jessán discovered that Pretty Boy's reprogramming had been only partially interrupted. She retained newly implanted knowledge of computer hacking and hand-to-hand combat and had become noticeably more ruthless and less troubled by the moral implications of her actions. Using those abilities, she uncovered the connection between Meridian Bank, Roche and the Reavers. ===Becoming Tyger Tiger=== With the Reavers already defeated, Jessán turned her attention to Roche and travelled to his territory in Madripoor. She began attacking his street-level operations throughout Lowtown, leaving surviving criminals with warnings that the Tyger was coming for him. The name derived from a nickname the Reavers themselves had used for her. Around this time, Wolverine found Dave Chapel tortured and dying from exposure in the desert. His investigation led him back to Madripoor, where he began searching for the mysterious figure known as "the Tiger". Jessán had established connections with O'Donnell and the staff of the Princess Bar. While Wolverine was there investigating the Tyger, he realised that he was being watched and confronted Jessán. She resisted him and managed to escape after a brief fight, not initially realising that he was one of the X-Men who had rescued her from the Reavers. Wolverine was subsequently overcome by Sapphire Styx and Razor-Fist and delivered to Roche. After surviving torture at the hands of the Inquisitor, Wolverine escaped Roche's compound, only to be badly beaten and thrown into the water. Jessán followed his unconscious body out to sea, rescued him from drowning and nursed him back to health aboard one of her vessels. After recovering, Wolverine began wearing an eye patch while operating in Madripoor in order to conceal the survival of the X-Men and adopted the local identity Patch. He learned that Jessán was the Tyger he had been seeking, while Jessán discovered that Patch was Wolverine. Jessán explained what Pretty Boy had done to her and announced her intention to destroy Roche and replace him as Madripoor's dominant crime lord. Wolverine objected that, as a member of the X-Men, he was supposed to oppose criminals such as Roche and Tyger. Jessán reminded him that she had just saved his life and persuaded him to assist her. Roche soon attempted to assassinate Tyger, with Wolverine saving her life and thereby cancelling the debt between them. Although free to leave, Wolverine nevertheless chose to continue helping her. Together they assaulted Roche's organisation, rescued O'Donnell and invaded Roche's stronghold. While Wolverine fought Razor-Fist, Tyger personally defeated two of Roche's leading operatives before confronting Roche himself and decapitating him with her sword. With Roche dead, Tyger seized his organisation and rose to the top of Madripoor's criminal underworld. Despite the damage Pretty Boy had done to her moral restraints, she retained enough of her former morality to impose limits upon her criminal empire, notably refusing to participate in the drug or slave trades. Following the family profession, she attended Harvard Business School, graduating magna cum laude, before returning to Singapore and taking a position at her family's Hoan International Bank. Though comparatively small, the institution had become successful enough to attract the attention of its competitors. The rival Meridian Bank feared the Hoan family's growing influence and secretly hired the Madripoor crime lord Roche to eliminate the competition. Roche in turn contracted the Reavers, who attacked Hoan International Bank while Jessán was working there. The Reavers massacred several members of her family and the bank's personnel, but spared Jessán because they believed her financial expertise could be useful to them. They abducted her and carried her to their Australian base at Cooterman's Creek. There, Pretty Boy attempted to cybernetically reprogram Jessán. The Reavers wanted her to administer the financial side of their criminal operation, but considered her morality, scruples and compassion liabilities. Pretty Boy therefore began erasing those restraints while downloading new knowledge and skills into her mind. The process was interrupted when the X-Men attacked the Reavers and rescued her. After debating what to do with her, the X-Men released Jessán, and their ally Roma returned her to the time and place from which she had been abducted. Jessán returned to the ruins of her family's bank as one of the massacre's only survivors. Rather than being welcomed home, her mysterious survival made her a pariah among both her extended family and Singapore's financial community. Banks refused to employ her, but she found herself unexpectedly unconcerned by the damage to her reputation. Investigating what had happened, Jessán discovered that Pretty Boy's reprogramming had been only partially interrupted. She retained newly implanted knowledge of computer hacking and hand-to-hand combat and had become noticeably more ruthless and less troubled by the moral implications of her actions. Using those abilities, she uncovered the connection between Meridian Bank, Roche and the Reavers. ===Becoming Tyger Tiger=== With the Reavers already defeated, Jessán turned her attention to Roche and travelled to his territory in Madripoor. She began attacking his street-level operations throughout Lowtown, leaving surviving criminals with warnings that the Tyger was coming for him. The name derived from a nickname the Reavers themselves had used for her. Around this time, Wolverine found Dave Chapel tortured and dying from exposure in the desert. His investigation led him back to Madripoor, where he began searching for the mysterious figure known as "the Tiger". Jessán had established connections with O'Donnell and the staff of the Princess Bar. While Wolverine was there investigating the Tyger, he realised that he was being watched and confronted Jessán. She resisted him and managed to escape after a brief fight, not initially realising that he was one of the X-Men who had rescued her from the Reavers. Wolverine was subsequently overcome by Sapphire Styx and Razor-Fist and delivered to Roche. After surviving torture at the hands of the Inquisitor, Wolverine escaped Roche's compound, only to be badly beaten and thrown into the water. Jessán followed his unconscious body out to sea, rescued him from drowning and nursed him back to health aboard one of her vessels. After recovering, Wolverine began wearing an eye patch while operating in Madripoor in order to conceal the survival of the X-Men and adopted the local identity Patch. He learned that Jessán was the Tyger he had been seeking, while Jessán discovered that Patch was Wolverine. Jessán explained what Pretty Boy had done to her and announced her intention to destroy Roche and replace him as Madripoor's dominant crime lord. Wolverine objected that, as a member of the X-Men, he was supposed to oppose criminals such as Roche and Tyger. Jessán reminded him that she had just saved his life and persuaded him to assist her. Roche soon attempted to assassinate Tyger, with Wolverine saving her life and thereby cancelling the debt between them. Although free to leave, Wolverine nevertheless chose to continue helping her. Together they assaulted Roche's organisation, rescued O'Donnell and invaded Roche's stronghold. While Wolverine fought Razor-Fist, Tyger personally defeated two of Roche's leading operatives before confronting Roche himself and decapitating him with her sword. With Roche dead, Tyger seized his organisation and rose to the top of Madripoor's criminal underworld. Despite the damage Pretty Boy had done to her moral restraints, she retained enough of her former morality to impose limits upon her criminal empire, notably refusing to participate in the drug or slave trades. jester ii.name: Jester II
jester ii.origin: Not much is known about the Jester, he was a criminal who was active during the late 1940s. He fancied himself the funniest man alive, although his jokes were very terrible. In 1948 he heard a radio broadcast of the Lee School's gag-writing competition hosted by teacher Jeff Mace, awarding the prize of $1000 to Dorothy Graham. Furious that he did not win, the Jester decided to commit a series of crimes to prove that he was the funniest person. His first target was wealthy Elwell Cluyon whose pet dog (a Mongolian breed) was stolen and held for ransom. The Jester left a bad joke and made a ransom demand which Cluyon paid in full. For his next robbery, the Jester and his gang attacked the home of Dorothy Graham to steal her prize money as it was being delivered by Jeff Mace and Fred Davis Jr. The Jester doused the lights and stole the money. Mace and Davis attacked the Jester as Captain America and Bucky, but the Jester managed to escape, leaving another one of his bad jokes behind. He then sought to steal Jeff Mace's first edition of Joe Miller's gag-writing book. He then attacked Mace's apartment, and despite further interference from Captain America and Bucky, managed to escape with the valuable first edition. However, the Jester's desire for fame and recognition proved to be his undoing. He fell for a trap laid out by Captain America where the Jester was lured to a local radio station to steal the Hen's Egg Diamond which was being worn at another award announcement for Dorothy Graham. When the Jester found himself at a live radio broadcast, he postponed his robbery in order to tell his jokes over the radio. Captain America and Bucky soon arrived and the Jester attempted to flee. He was chased by Captain America to the top of the broadcasting tower and was saved from a fatal flaw. Captain America then forced the Jester to laugh on air to Dorothy's jokes before turning him over to the authorities. According to Bucky, the Jester was sentenced to 99 years in prison for his crimes. The ultimate fate of the Jester is unknown.

However, examination of the two characters shows that they are vastly different in appearance and motivations. Pinkham was depicted as an older man bent on revenge over a childhood of being bullied and the butt of practical jokes, while this Jester is depicted as a younger man who wishes to be recognized for his jokes.

To get the Hen's Egg Diamond!"

jesus badalemente.name: Jesus Badalemente
jesus badalemente.origin: thumb|left|150px|Jesus, special effects artist and mannikin maker for the haunted house Jesus Badalemente claims that, apparently when he was very young, he lost his mother and his father was frequently in jail, leading him to spend long stretches of time walking the Coney Island boardwalk while his family crumbled. Jesus initially worked as a special effects technician, crafting monsters to be used in movies, but abandoned the field; he said he refused to prostitute his own work and that it was a too close industry, but those may have been excuses. Jesus moved to build props for the Coney Island amusement park haunted house, for which he moved to a loft close to the park itself (at a later point, Tracy Collins compared Jesus' dwelling with a warehouse). Jesus also took care of one to three cats. Walking through Brooklyn by night, Jesus was assaulted by Vince's band of muggers, who got only three dollars in cash from him. Jesus was then rescued by fearsome cyborg Deathlok. Noticing that the police was looking for Deathlok, Jesus offered him shelter at his home. Deathlok accepted and introduced himself as Michael Collins, prompting Jesus to call him Mike - the only person who had called him that. Jesus eventually called Deathlok "Iron Mike" too. thumb|right|During the Coney Island battle, Jesus grabs a weapon At Jesus', Deathlok rested but had a nightmare about how he had recently committed a massacre in Estrella. Waking up, Deathlok decided to do something about it, even if Jesus was against the idea. Deathlok used Jesus' telephone to contact, via cyberspace, his friend Jim Dworman, asking him to steal documents about the Estrella situation. The people who had created Deathlok, Cybertek Systems, were trying to find and recapture him, and they were monitoring Dworman's communications, so they traced the phone and found Deathlok's location in Coney Island. They then sent a high-tech assault team led by Mainframe and using a team of agents equipped with Terminal Armor, Dragonfly flying vehicles and the SQ1 submarine, to capture Deathlok. Mainframe arranged an open battle in the middle of the day, attacking both Jesus' home and the park full of visitors, prompting Deathlok to reveal himself to protect them. Deathlok resisted capture, and Jesus grabbed a huge rifle dropped by one of the enemies, using it to attack the SQ1 and to threaten Mainframe - and then, once Mainframe had been defeated, Jesus tried to justify his non-cynical behavior. The police arrested Mainframe, while Deathlok escaped notice and stole a Dragonfly to go back to Estrella after saying his goodbye to Jesus. Jesus decided to keep the weapon in case he was involved with more superhuman threats. Deathlok returned to the United States, wrecking Cybertek in the process and leading to the arrest of many of the people responsible for his non-voluntary cyborgization, but he decided not to return with his family because he had a monstrous appearance and may attract hostile attention. Instead, he returned to Jesus and became his roommate. Jesus gave Deathlok some support, mostly moral, when Deathlok went to meet fellow cyborg Misty Knight (who refused to talk in front of Jesus because he was not a cyborg) and when Deathlok discovered his son Nick was involved in illegal drug dealing. For a month, Jesus accepted Deathlok as his roommate, but after a month he prompted Deathlok to contribute to the expenses, and Deathlok himself had been considering working as a computer science consultant. Before Deathlok started with that, however, Jesus saw his own income threatened by the sudden appearance of a new special effects professional, Mr. FX, who was selling better monsters to the haunted house. Investigating a case of missing people, Deathlok and some allies discovered that Mr. FX was kidnapping and drugging people for his job but, having been discovered, Mr. FX ran away, meaning that Jesus' job was no longer in danger. Deathlok only gave Jesus some help at home while building together the monsters. thumb|right|Deathlok helps Jesus crafting monsters When they discovered that Mainframe was free, Jesus revealed he had kept the high-tech weapon, but Deathlok opposed to that kind of aggressive approach and broke it. He then helped Jesus building a figure of Frankenstein's Monster (which Deathlok compared to his own situation) - then Mainframe used his powers to turn Jesus' monsters against Deathlok! Deathlok went outside after Mainframe, only to be captured, but he released himself later. Not much later, Deathlok was controlled by the demon Nightmare. He sleepwalked at Jesus', punching Jesus in the face and breaking the later's glasses - but, instead of getting angry at Deathlok, Jesus followed him and, when Deathlok threatened other people, Jesus called his attention, trying to reach him with words. The Ghost Rider rode in and, believing Deathlok to be a villain, tried to fight him; and Jesus risked himself by confronting the awe-inspiring Rider. The Rider s
jesus badalemente.bio: Deathlok eventually disappeared when he was transported by an alien intelligence to another planet, where he remained for years until he could return home. He then retook contact with his family, but it is unrevealed whether he contacted Jesus or not. | Powers = | Abilities = Jesus is a professional prop maker, with the expertise and abilities of his field. He has several other skills, including driving a van (which is useful to move his work), grilling, painting on canvas, and Deathlok claimed that Jesus had more knowledge about art history than anyone Deathlok had ever known before. | Weaknesses = | Equipment = | Transportation = Owns and uses a van to move through New York City. | Weapons = | Notes = * Surname revealed in , story 4. His first name is spelled Jesus without a diacritic, except in , in which Deathlok calls him "Jesús". His skin color has changed inconsistently in his appearances, with him being white-skinned, brown-skinned, and yellow-skinned. In , Jesus shouts in Spanish "Dios mío! [sic.] Madre de Dios!", the only instance in which he speaks other language than English. It is unconfirmed whether Jesus is fluent in Spanish or he only knows a few words. A plot related to Jesus in and , is never solved: Belinda threatens Jesus so that he'd put a scanner on Deathlok, claiming that this was on Deathlok's best interests; Jesus tries to do it, fails - and we hear nothing else about this. | Trivia = * Jesus has openly admitted that he likes X-rated movies. Jesus has refused to join his friend Deathlok on a flight trip, apparently as this scared him. Jesus has presented a cynic attitude to the outer world, giving the appearance of a tough guy, but was really a good-hearted man willing to risk his own safety for his friends and for what he knows is right. Deathlok, who called Jesus his only friend (although Deathlok also considered Jim Dworman a friend), has made an amateur diagnostic on Jesus that suggests Jesus suffers from neurosis. | Marvel = | Wikipedia = | Links =

jet dixon.name: Jet Dixon
jet dixon.origin: Jet Dixon resides on Earth-5106 a reality where space travel and exploration blossomed in the 1950s. He is the great-grandson of famous rocket pilot John Dixon who saved the Earth from destruction in 1955. By the year 2000 he was a member of the Space Squadron peacekeeping force that defended planets under direction of the Galaxy organization a united federation of known planets on Earth's solar system. He was engaged to Dawn Revere the daughter of Galaxy Chief and Space Squadron head Bennett "Blast" Revere, however Bennett refused to allow them to get married as his own wife had died due to the stress of his career and did not wish his daughter to suffer the same fate. Despite this, Bennett found Jet to be a capable leader and appointed him field commander of Space Squadron, much to the chagrin of his son Edgar who became determined to discredit Jet and take his place in Space Squadron. Under Jet's command were raw cadet Rusty Blake and science officer LLA 38 among others. Some of his early missions saw him combating rebel factions of the Oranois and Spheroid races. After being appointed field commander of Space Squadron, Jet's first mission was to stop mad scientist Tombalo who threatened to destroy rockets carrying Galaxy delegates with his "Electro-Arc" weapon. With the aid of LLA 38, Jet eliminated Tombalo despite interference from Edgar. Later he took Dawn with him to the planet Mercury to see the memorial placed in the memory of his great-grandfather and told her how John Dixon saved the Earth from destruction. After returning to Earth, Jet was assigned to meet with members of the VDBN, a sect of barbaric Martians who were seeking to learn the ways of peace. He met their leader Mxxptrm and invited them to Earth. There, Jet had to battle Mxxptrm when he became jealous of Jet's relationship with Dawn. Beating Mxxptrm in battle, Jet spared his life, a compassion alien to the Martian leader which eventually led to Mxxptrm and his people renouncing their violent ways. Jet welcomed Mxxptrm into the Space Squadron, nicknaming him Max. Jet was next assigned to investigate what force was causing the Mercurians to give into their evil personas. Taking the Space Squadron to Mercury they learned that the Sun had moved closer to Mercury increasing the temperature and causing the transformation in the Mercurians. While Jet led the Squadron in fighting off the insane Mercruians, LLA 38's science-based Squad 3 built a magnetic device to return the Sun to its original orbit ending the conflict before Edgar could convince the Galaxy council to go to war against Mercury. When LLA 38 developed a the disaster detective Diastro-Ray they learned of a dangerous volcanic eruption on Neptune's Dead Sea. Going to investigate they defended the Fish-Men of Neptune from their mortal enemies the vampiric Octopus-Men, a mission that was almost a failure thanks to the interference of Edgar who was stopped in time by his sister Dawn. Back on Earth, Jet and Dawn once more asked Bennett to allow them to get married but he once more refused. Shortly thereafter, Jet and his team went on a routine mission unaware that Edgar had planted a crate of Space Demons onboard their ship, the Solar 1 in an attempt to frame Jet for harboring the illegal creatures. However the plan backfired when the creatures were accidentally freed and they instinctually went after their captors -- Edgar Revere. Jet and his squad then saved Edgar from the Space Demons, an Jet promised not to expose Edgar out of respect for his father. Jet and his crew next travelled to the Moon where the Moonmen were hosting the 2000 Olympics. There Moonmen Drago and Ura plotted to use their hypnotic powers to force Jet to lose the rocket race competition in an effort to discredit Earth's standing in the Galaxy council. To this end, Ura tried to seduce Jet, using her powers to put him in her thrall. Detecting this, LLA 38 pretended to betray his friends and convinced Drago to use his powers on Jet also, knowing that it would counteract Ura's hypnosis and free Jet from their control. As a result, Jet was able to win the rocket race, foiling their plot. Upon their return to Earth, Jet and his comrades were shocked to find that Boz, an intergalactic criminal had taken the Galaxy council hostage in order to take over the solar system, using his army of tentacles to incapacitate all Galaxy worlds. In response to this, Jet and his crew dumped lethal Atomic Dust on Boz, killing him and ending the threat of his tentacles. Later that year, Jet was awarded the medal of valor during a live telecast. However the ceremonies were interrupted by Edgar Revere who called Jet a coward for not agreeing to undergo testing of Dr. Kalandra's new experimental gas. Duty bound, Jet and his crew agreed to have the new gas tested on them. By the year 2000 he was a member of the Space Squadron peacekeeping force that defended planets under direction of the Galaxy organization a united federation of known planets on Earth's solar system. He was engaged to Dawn Revere the daughter of Galaxy Chief and Space Squadron head Bennett "Blast" Revere, however Bennett refused to allow them to get married as his own wife had died due to the stress of his career and did not wish his daughter to suffer the same fate. Despite this, Bennett found Jet to be a capable leader and appointed him field commander of Space Squadron, much to the chagrin of his son Edgar who became determined to discredit Jet and take his place in Space Squadron. Under Jet's command were raw cadet Rusty Blake and science officer LLA 38 among others. Some of his early missions saw him combating rebel factions of the Oranois and Spheroid races. After being appointed field commander of Space Squadron, Jet's first mission was to stop mad scientist Tombalo who threatened to destroy rockets carrying Galaxy delegates with his "Electro-Arc" weapon. With the aid of LLA 38, Jet eliminated Tombalo despite interference from Edgar. Later he took Dawn with him to the planet Mercury to see the memorial placed in the memory of his great-grandfather and told her how John Dixon saved the Earth from destruction. After returning to Earth, Jet was assigned to meet with members of the VDBN, a sect of barbaric Martians who were seeking to learn the ways of peace. He met their leader Mxxptrm and invited them to Earth. There, Jet had to battle Mxxptrm when he became jealous of Jet's relationship with Dawn. Beating Mxxptrm in battle, Jet spared his life, a compassion alien to the Martian leader which eventually led to Mxxptrm and his people renouncing their violent ways. Jet welcomed Mxxptrm into the Space Squadron, nicknaming him Max. Jet was next assigned to investigate what force was causing the Mercurians to give into their evil personas. Taking the Space Squadron to Mercury they learned that the Sun had moved closer to Mercury increasing the temperature and causing the transformation in the Mercurians. While Jet led the Squadron in fighting off the insane Mercruians, LLA 38's science-based Squad 3 built a magnetic device to return the Sun to its original orbit ending the conflict before Edgar could convince the Galaxy council to go to war against Mercury. When LLA 38 developed a the disaster detective Diastro-Ray they learned of a dangerous volcanic eruption on Neptune's Dead Sea. Going to investigate they defended the Fish-Men of Neptune from their mortal enemies the vampiric Octopus-Men, a mission that was almost a failure thanks to the interference of Edgar who was stopped in time by his sister Dawn. Back on Earth, Jet and Dawn once more asked Bennett to allow them to get married but he once more refused. Shortly thereafter, Jet and his team went on a routine mission unaware that Edgar had planted a crate of Space Demons onboard their ship, the Solar 1 in an attempt to frame Jet for harboring the illegal creatures. However the plan backfired when the creatures were accidentally freed and they instinctually went after their captors -- Edgar Revere. Jet and his squad then saved Edgar from the Space Demons, an Jet promised not to expose Edgar out of respect for his father. Jet and his crew next travelled to the Moon where the Moonmen were hosting the 2000 Olympics. There Moonmen Drago and Ura plotted to use their hypnotic powers to force Jet to lose the rocket race competition in an effort to discredit Earth's standing in the Galaxy council. To this end, Ura tried to seduce Jet, using her powers to put him in her thrall. Detecting this, LLA 38 pretended to betray his friends and convinced Drago to use his powers on Jet also, knowing that it would counteract Ura's hypnosis and free Jet from their control. As a result, Jet was able to win the rocket race, foiling their plot. Upon their return to Earth, Jet and his comrades were shocked to find that Boz, an intergalactic criminal had taken the Galaxy council hostage in order to take over the solar system, using his army of tentacles to incapacitate all Galaxy worlds. In response to this, Jet and his crew dumped lethal Atomic Dust on Boz, killing him and ending the threat of his tentacles. Later that year, Jet was awarded the medal of valor during a live telecast. However the ceremonies were interrupted by Edgar Revere who called Jet a coward for not agreeing to undergo testing of Dr. Kalandra's new experimental gas. Duty bound, Jet and his crew agreed to have the new gas tested on them. While the gas had the desired effect of making them temporarily immune to pain, hunger and the elements the gas also had an the unexpected side effect of putting Jet and hi
weapons: Jet primarily uses a gun that fires "atomic bullets"

jet zola.name: Jet Zola
jet zola.origin: Jet is the daughter of Arnim Zola and the sister of Ian Zola (Nomad). She was the self-proclaimed princess of Dimension Z. Jet renounced her father and helped Captain America return to his reality where Jet currently resides. She temporarily lived with Steve Rogers in his Brooklyn residence, where she also knew Falcon. Sam didn't really trust her, sharing this opinion with S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Maria Hill. She was approached by the Red Skull, who was acting upon an oath to aid her should she come to this Dimension without her father, but she refused his aid. ===Iron Nail=== Cap went to Nrosvekistan trying to stop Nuke from causing another World War. There, photos of Daily Bugle's reporter Samantha Chan were someway manipulated, and Cap was accused by the media of being an accomplice of Simpson. Back to Brooklyn, Steve and Jet talked about what happened there and how much important for Cap his "public image" is. Then, Steve told Jet about the fact that he almost killed Nuke, even knowing about his mind problems and the fact that he was only a puppet, going against every ideal he always possessed. Jet answered Steve that maybe he needs to be unmerciful sometimes, like Zolas are, to prevent people like Nuke from hurting other ones again. Then she and Cap saved a businessman from an attack of the Shaolin Scientist Squad. After Nuke literally exploded in a S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier murdering several agents, Falcon and Nick Fury were presumed dead, but thanks to Jet's super-hearing Falcon's discovered to be wounded but still alive. Then Maria Hill informed Steve of the escape of the Weapon Minus project, that is none other than Dr. Mindbubble, that was trying to take S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret weapon Gungnir. Jet then, after a request by Steve, found an old cyborg that was one of the supervisors of the Weapon Minus project, trying to know something more about Mindbubble. Zola's daughter found out what the power of Weapon Minus was: he could create "Dream Bubbles" that captured the mind of an opponent, making him believe to live in another reality full of his most beautiful dreams, while he could control them with illusions in this distorted reality. The only solution to escape from it was to commit suicide, kill yourself in the distorted reality, if you can understand that you're part of an illusion. thumb|280px|Jet with the Weapon Minus Cyborg While she's watching some TV, Jet got to know about the destruction of two Helicarriers by an out of control Gungnir and started to worry about what could be happened to Cap. Meanwhile, Steve Rogers was "living" one of Mindbubble's illusions: the attack is over, Falcon, Jet, and the Winter Soldier saved the world, Ian and Sharon are alive and outside there's a parade dedicated to Steve Rogers. Cap understood that he's in one of Doc illusions and virtually kills himself, getting free of the mind control. Then, both the Iron Nail and Mindbubble attacked him, but Jet arrived on an aircraft saving him, then she started fighting the Iron Nail while Cap defeated Mindbubble. ===Super-Soldier No More=== After Cap has stopped Gungnir from erasing Nrosvekistan, we find Jet asleep in Falcon's bed after a lively night. The evening before, Jet and Sam drank some wine and, probably drunk, they had some fun together. When Falcon woke up, he's shocked discovering himself in bed with Jet, that calmed Sam saying that she's really starting to like him and that it was her effective "first time", saying that she'd like to do it again. Then, while the two are hugging, Jet saw Arnim Zola's tower right in the middle of New York. Then, after Steve Rogers discovered that Ian is still alive, Falcon and Jet contacted Cap to warn him and the Avengers that his father is attacking NY with a new breed of his Mutates. Then she told Steve that maybe she knows a way that will let her and Falcon enter the tower without her father noticing it. She said to the Avengers to still do what Arnim is expecting, facing the army of mutates, while she and Sam take Zola down from inside. Then, she started talking with Falcon, saying that this way of doing things isn't his father style: he would never have been so dramatic. She knows that Arnim Zola prefers doing things in a completely opposite way, so she's thinking about a deeper game behind the whole thing. When Falcon then asked about what relationship there is between her and Arnim, she answered that for her Zola is nothing but an enemy now. Then she underlined that this Mutates attack is only a distraction. Jet's plan is stopping the mind connection that Arnim has with the Mutates. When Sam tried out to talk, she stopped him, saying that an operation like this needs a woman's touch and that she doesn't want Falcon to get killed, because she likes him. Then she gave Wilson a kiss. thumb|356px|Jet fighting some Mutates inside Arnim's tower Jet distracted then some mutates, that still recognize her as the princess of Zolandia, saying that someone inside the tower betrayed their

jeutar morat.name: Jeutar Mörat
jeutar morat.origin: Jeutar Mörat was a bounty hunter who was trying to hunt down Gamora due to the price put on her head by the Universal Chruch of Truth, using an army of genetically modified Shock-Clones. After a failed attempt to capture Gamora in an unidentified planet, Mörat was able to pin down Gamora's location after she escaped. Mörat's Shock-Clones arrived to Manhattan, where Gamora's spaceship had crashed, and accidentally targeted both Gamora and She-Hulk, who they had mistaken for the former. She-Hulk recovered Gamora from the crash-landing site, and helped her recover from the poison injected in her system by the Shock-Clones during the previous battle. When Mörat and his army confronted them, She-Hulk, disguised as Gamora, made Mörat believe she had acquired cloning technology in order to intimidate him, forcing him to retreat and never attempt to capture Gamora again.

jewel banner.name: Jewel Banner
jewel banner.origin: Jewel was one of the many Hulks who deserted the Hulk Gang at some point for being mistreated by their leader, Pappy Banner. After Logan killed Pappy and most of the Hulk Gang members, Jewel and the other remaining Hulks were recruited by the Maestro, an alternate dimension version of Pappy, to build a paradise for themselves in Earth-616.

jexia krill.name: Jexia Krill
jexia krill.species: Alien infected and turned into a Brood
jexia krill.origin: Jexia Krill was from an alien race from an unidentified planet. He and his parents went out to explore the galaxy in search of new planets to colonize. During their travels they encountered a distress signal and went to investigate. They discovered the signal was a trap by a Brood-Infested Acanti, and attempted to flee but their vessel was boarded. Jexia, their sibling and mother were infected and transformed into Brood, his father Tyrus was similarly infected but was able to inject himself with a depressant which suppressed the infection. Ulara then left in the escape pod. Eventually Jexia and the brood nest took root on Earth in the Hotel Ripley on Earth, bringing them up against Wolverine and a vengeful Tyrus. After they managed to take out all the Brood, Krill left himself transform into a Brood, tricking Wolverine into killing him. As Krill lay dying he revealed the full truth to Wolverine, who laid Krill with his dying family. Wolverine returned their bodies to the ship and with Beast's help they returned the ship to their homeworld.

During their travels they encountered a distress signal and went to investigate. They discovered the signal was a trap by a Brood-Infested Acanti, and attempted to flee but their vessel was boarded. Jexia, their sibling and mother were infected and transformed into Brood, his father Tyrus was similarly infected but was able to inject himself with a depressant which suppressed the infection. Ulara then left in the escape pod. Eventually Jexia and the brood nest took root on Earth in the Hotel Ripley on Earth, bringing them up against Wolverine and a vengeful Tyrus. After they managed to take out all the Brood, Krill left himself transform into a Brood, tricking Wolverine into killing him. As Krill lay dying he revealed the full truth to Wolverine, who laid Krill with his dying family. Wolverine returned their bodies to the ship and with Beast's help they returned the ship to their homeworld.

jhandark.name: Jhandark
jhandark.origin: Jhandark was a member of the telepathic Lemurian sect known as The Ancients. After stealing the Serpent Crown from the Lemurian king Naga the group founded a colony on the surface of Antarctica. Jhandark devised the potion that allowed her people to breathe on the surface. Jhandark's husband Bekkit was eventually murdered by his brother Psycatos after he became corrupted by the crown.

jhebbal sag.name: Jhebbal Sag
jhebbal sag.origin: ===Origins and early years=== Jhebbal Sag was described as an "ancient god of darkness and fear" a bestial deity, and a "demi-human". It was said that he was once worshiped by all living things, men and beasts alike, when they spoke the same tongue. For millennia, he dwelt in a netherworld. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== During the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, Jhebbal Sag was worshiped by the Picts of the Pictish Isles. His worship was seemingly halted among the Borni under Brule the Spear-Slayer's rule as chieftain, but went on as the Borni rekindled altars to Jhebbal Sag after having chosen a wizard as chieftain of their tribe, the shaman Ba-Thek. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age, Jhebbal Sag was worshiped by the Picts, who offered him human sacrifices. Only some beasts remembered Jhebbal Sag's secret tongue and obeyed it, including baboons, birds of prey, crocodiles, leopards, serpents, and hyenas. Taken in a mist-enshrouded trance at Abombi, the exile Ajaga learned Jhebbal Sag's secret tongue and used it to form an army of beasts of the jungle and of like-minded exiles, intending to carve a kingdom on the Black Coast. Ajaga presented himself as the heir of Jhebbal Sag. After capturing Conan and Bêlit, he pretended to communicate with Jhebbal Sag (or actually did?) in a trance, and ordered their death.

jho.name: Jho
jho.origin: Jho and his partner Chipp were two Sparkitects hired by Mojo to use the power of the Sparkitendrils to make interesting the stale life of Howard the Duck, who was the unwitting protagonist of his own reality show, which was secretly filmed by Mojo and broadcast across the galaxy. When Mojo started blackmailing Chipp and Jho, threatening to reveal their operations to their superiors, the two Sparkitects decided to influence Howard's life and send him right to Mojo, hoping it would stop Mojo and his plans. However, Chipp and Jho realized Mojo was eventually going to find out they were trying to betray him. The two Sparkitects flew to the Earth in an attempt to intercept Mojo before he could retaliate against them. When they arrived to the scene of Mojo's fight against Howard the Duck, Chipp tried to defuse the situation and convince Mojo to calm down in exchange of trying to talk their bosses into agreeing to make Mojo the protagonist of the next big crossover, but Mojo refused. The Iron Punisher joined the brawl, having being part of a backup plan put in motion back in Sparkitron in case Mojo didn't give in. The distraction caused by this turn of events gave Chipp the opportunity to run back to his ship, but Howard tackled him, fueled by rage for having being victim of the Sparkitects' manipulation. Jho escaped alone on his and Chipp's ship after witnessing the destruction caused by the Iron Punisher, which risked the life of Howard's ally Biggs, a character introduced into Howard's life by Chipp and Jho which had been based on Jho's very own cat, Biggs-Prime, claiming that he needed to put an end to this situation. Jho returned to Sparkitron only to find his supervisor Whil was dismantling his and Chipp's control terminal. However, with the help of Ry-N and his portable version, Jho managed to access his account and bring Howard back to life, who had just been stabbed by Chipp, by manipulating Dr. Strange into making his soul return to his body. Following Chipp's defeat, Jho was arrested together with him. He decided to give Biggs-Prime to the Iron Punisher so it could take care of him.

jhoatun lau.name: Jhoatun Lau
jhoatun lau.origin: ===Origin=== An eldritch god worshipped long before the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, Jhoatun Lau was said to live in his icy domain beyond the . He could only be summoned when Earth was in cosmic alignment with a planet beyond the orbit of Pluto, which only occurred "once a millennium". ===Elder Days === The last conjunction happened 113,000 years ago. At that time, a cult worshipping Jhoatun Lau attempted to summon him by filling a massive stone bowl with the blood of warriors, in the hopes that he would take them with him when he returned to his palace among the stars. However, the eldritch god seemingly found his worshippers' sacrifice inadequate and devoured them all before somehow returning back to his domain. ===Hyborian Age=== Jhoatun Lau's cult persisted into the Hyborian Age, when the City of Sickles was built as a place of worship to the dark god. ===Modern Age=== In the Modern Age, the City of Sickles, now located in the Savage Land, was used by cultists led by Kulan Gath, a time-displaced evil sorcerer from the Hyborian Age, who sought to summon Jhoatun Lau to Earth. Gath's cult allied themselves with the other magic sects such as Egyptian cultists and the Hand in order to provide a sufficient sacrifice to succeed the rite, gathering exemplary people from all over the world and sacrificing them. With the unwilling assistance of Doctor Voodoo, Logan, and Conan of Cimmeria, Kulan Gath was successful in performing the right and summoned the Marrow God to Earth. He was displaced to Shangai were he began to destroy everything in his path. However, Elektra managed to set up a trap using an arrow to knock him down, and Wolverine, with the help of Venom and Conan was able to destroy his brain getting through his skull, permanently killing him.

transportation: Blood Portal: Jhoatun Lau can only manifest on Earth when that planet is in conjunction with another planet beyond Pluto, and is summoned through a portal of blood drained from the very best specimens humanity has to offer.

Lovecraft's Yuggoth), located at the very edge of the Solar System, (possibly Pluto), Jhoatun Lau is seemingly inspired by the gods and monsters of the Cthulhu Mythos, which Conan's mythos is tied to.

ji shuangshuang.name: Ji Shuangshuang
ji shuangshuang.species: Human descended from the Xian Nü-wa
ji shuangshuang.origin: Ji Shuangshuang was a demon hunter and the descendant of Nü-wa. She began hunting demons after the seal in Chiyou's first tomb was broken and the Sword of Fu Xi was taken. Following three of the demons to Shanghai, she discovered Lin Lie and the Sword and one of Chiyou's Spirit Orbs in his possession. After Lie demanded answers, she stabbed him with the sword showing him a vision of their ancestors defeating Chiyou. Seeking other demons in the area, she took the soul of Chiyou and left. Doctor Strange used his magic to teleport Lie to Shuangshuang so that Lie could learn the value of teamwork in finding his missing father. After they defeated the demons, Shuangshuang was contacted by her grandmother, who ordered her to return to home with Lie and the Sword. The two recruited Lie's friend Ah Cheng to drive them to Gansu, which originally went off to a bad start when Shuangshuang beat up Cheng for stealing a phone from an obnoxious businessman. Shuangshuang and her friends helped her grandmother and the Nü-wa Clan defend the Nü-wa mansion when it was attacked by Chiyou's demons. Afterwards, Xiangyun took Shuangshuang and Lie to the tomb containing Chiyou's body and used her magic to show memories of Chiyou's sealing and release, as well as the last moments of Lie's father before his disappearance. Shuangshuang was ordered by her grandmother to start training Lie. Shuangshuang was later entrusted with the Bands of Nü-wa by Xiangyun. When Lin Feng arrived at the Nü-wa mansion with a horde of Chiyou's demons, including a giant demonic centipede, to destroy Chiyou's second tomb, Shuangshuang and the Nü-wa Clan attempted to stop him, but were defeated. Feng then took the Bands from Shuangshuang's unconscious body.

ji xiangyun.name: Ji Xiangyun
ji xiangyun.species: Human descended from the Xian Nü-wa
ji xiangyun.origin: Ji Xiangyun was a descendant of Nü-wa and chief of the Nü-wa Clan. After the seal in Chiyou's first tomb was broken and the Sword of Fu Xi was taken, Xiangyun sent her granddaughter Ji Shuangshuang on a mission to defeat the demons released from the broken seal. After Shaungshuang found the Sword and one of Chiyou's Spirit Orbs in the possession of Fu Xi's descendant Lin Lie in Shanghai, Xiangyun ordered her to bring Lie and the items to their mansion in Gansu. When the Nü-wa Clan's headquarters was attacked by Chiyou's demons looking for his sealed body, Xiangyun used the Bands of Nü-wa to destroy them. Xiangyun gave Lie a formal greeting on behalf of the Nü-wa Clan, shocking everyone, and took him and Shuangshaung to Chiyou's tomb where she her magic to show memories of Chiyou's sealing and release, as well as the last moments of Lie's father before his disappearance. Xiangyun ordered Shuangshuang to start training Lie. Xiangyun later passed the Bands down to Shaungshuang.

As that bus drove off a bridge, Spider-Man prevented it from falling by restraining it using his web, and swooped in to rescue the occupants. On the way to the Savage Land, Wolverine gave her the code-name "Sprite", as a tribute to Logan's "favourite X-Man", and told her to learn about this name. ===Krakoa=== Like countless other mutants, she joined the mutant-only nation of Krakoa.

jia yi.name: Jia-Yi
jia yi.origin: Jia-Yi was the daughter of a man obsessed with robots, who was cold and distant to his child and pushed her to focus on her studies, which included lessons on time travel. She was contacted by a powerful telepath named David Haller, who through a series of clues led her to the location of his cult, where a man told her that she would be known as "Switch". Her first conversation with David himself was interrupted by Division 3, who attacked and killed David, forcing Switch to travel back in time and warn him of the danger. Her first attempt to do so had failed and the second one led to an encounter with Amahl Farouk on the astral plane. However, Switch was able to escape Farouk and warn David in time for him to teleport his entire compound away from the forces of Division 3 that were on his doorstep.

jian feeta.name: Jian Feeta
jian feeta.origin: Jian Feeta is an employee at Fantastic Four, Inc.. She was assigned to assist Johnny Storm in his new role as COO at the company. Despite his reluctance, Jian supported Johnny. She witnessed his offer to license Reed Richards' unstable molecular fabric for fashion mogul, Jacob Suarti. She was forced to leave when Modulus attacked. Jian joined Johnny in not only stopping Suarti's plan to reverse engineer the fabric, but also ousting two FF, Inc. employees who planned to overthrow Johnny. He later rescued her from the unstable molecules that had broken out. Afterwards, Jian told Susan Storm that Johnny had excellent ideas despite his flaws. Jian was with Johnny when he was hoping to break the land speed record in the Fireball X-S vehicle. He was forced to vacate when reporter Sheila Donner and her pilot's helicopter got caught in the sonic boom. Jian told Johnny that the accident was not his fault. Afterwards, she reminded Johnny of his meeting with Mike Snow. Jian and Johnny headed to the Balkans to look into the Locust Project. She fulfilled a sidekick role for the entire adventure. By the end, she commented on Johnny's height; stating that he is taller and proceeds to walk with him, holding his arm, implying a slight attraction. Over the next couple of months, Jian had become Johnny's co-financial manager, fully enjoying his company. Despite the recent things that had happened with the Fantastic Four, she assured Johnny that she was not looking for another job. She once again told Susan of her brother's unusual way of dealing with other businesses and how easily he adapted to the situation.
